evidence_reviews_target_ck.name: evidence_reviews_target_ck

evidence_sources_verified_ck.name: evidence_sources_verified_ck
evidence_sources_verified_ck.value: "evidence_sources"."verification_status" NOT IN ('verified','verified_with_corrections') OR ("evidence_sources"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "evidence_sources"."verification_method" IS NOT NULL)

method_variables_range_ck.name: method_variables_range_ck
method_variables_range_ck.value: "method_variables"."min_value" IS NULL OR "method_variables"."max_value" IS NULL OR "method_variables"."min_value" <= "method_variables"."max_value"

exercise_sets_reps_ck.name: exercise_sets_reps_ck
exercise_sets_reps_ck.value: "exercise_sets"."reps_min" IS NULL OR "exercise_sets"."reps_max" IS NULL OR "exercise_sets"."reps_min" <= "exercise_sets"."reps_max"

exercise_sets_rir_ck.name: exercise_sets_rir_ck
exercise_sets_rir_ck.value: ("exercise_sets"."rir_min" IS NULL OR "exercise_sets"."rir_min" BETWEEN 0 AND 10) AND ("exercise_sets"."rir_max" IS NULL OR "exercise_sets"."rir_max" BETWEEN 0 AND 10) AND ("exercise_sets"."rir_min" IS NULL OR "exercise_sets"."rir_max" IS NULL OR "exercise_sets"."rir_min" <= "exercise_sets"."rir_max")

exercise_sets_rpe_ck.name: exercise_sets_rpe_ck
exercise_sets_rpe_ck.value: "exercise_sets"."rpe_target" IS NULL OR ("exercise_sets"."rpe_target" BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND ("exercise_sets"."rpe_target" * 2) = trunc("exercise_sets"."rpe_target" * 2))

session_exercises_reps_ck.name: session_exercises_reps_ck
session_exercises_reps_ck.value: "session_exercises"."reps_min" IS NULL OR "session_exercises"."reps_max" IS NULL OR "session_exercises"."reps_min" <= "session_exercises"."reps_max"

session_exercises_rir_ck.name: session_exercises_rir_ck
session_exercises_rir_ck.value: ("session_exercises"."rir_min" IS NULL OR "session_exercises"."rir_min" BETWEEN 0 AND 10) AND ("session_exercises"."rir_max" IS NULL OR "session_exercises"."rir_max" BETWEEN 0 AND 10) AND ("session_exercises"."rir_min" IS NULL OR "session_exercises"."rir_max" IS NULL OR "session_exercises"."rir_min" <= "session_exercises"."rir_max")

session_exercises_rpe_ck.name: session_exercises_rpe_ck
session_exercises_rpe_ck.value: "session_exercises"."rpe_target" IS NULL OR ("session_exercises"."rpe_target" BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND ("session_exercises"."rpe_target" * 2) = trunc("session_exercises"."rpe_target" * 2))

training_plans_dates_ck.name: training_plans_dates_ck
training_plans_dates_ck.value: "training_plans"."end_date" IS NULL OR "training_plans"."start_date" IS NULL OR "training_plans"."end_date" >= "training_plans"."start_date"

recommendations_decided_ck.name: recommendations_decided_ck
recommendations_decided_ck.value: "recommendations"."status" = 'proposed' OR "recommendations"."status" = 'superseded' OR "recommendations"."status" = 'expired' OR "recommendations"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL
